articleTitle: Research on the detecting system of distributed nodes based on RS-485 bus
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In order to achieve the largest number of distributed network nodes and increase the communication security of network system in the conditions of long-range and high data rate, we introduce registration mechanism of communication nodes with distributed network nodes as the research object in this paper. With the application of single chip microcomputer (SCM) technology, we designed and implemented network system based on RS-485 bus, analysis several factors that affect the RS-485 network, explained the overall structure of the system and designed strictly closed communication protocols. 3000 communication nodes address were simulated by using 200 nodes. The registration of the nodes was comprehensive tested, and the distribution of 3000 nodes' pseudorandom register codes was statistics. In the conditions of using RS-485 bus drivers with 256 maximal nominal value of the node number, the distance of transmission cable within 200 m and baud rate of 115200bps, the result shows that the distributed network testing system is stable, network communication is reliable and better results are achieved.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The application study of middleware based on HL7 in multi-parameter monitor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Security analysis of VLAN-based Virtual Desktop Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: VDI (Virtual Desktop Infrastructure) is paid more and more attention at present. It helps enterprises integrate IT resources, reduce costs and achieve green computing. However, it simultaneously generates new demands on protecting data and enterprise security infrastructure. In order to address this problem, this paper puts forward a new infrastructure based on VLAN, and makes a security analysis of VLAN-based VDI.

articleTitle: A load balancing method based on genetic clonal annealing strategy in grid environments
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Load balancing is a very important and complex problem in grid computing. Grid computing differs from traditional high performance computing systems in the heterogeneity of the computing nodes and communication links, as well as background workloads that may be present in the computing nodes. This paper combined with the advantages of genetic algorithm, clonal selection algorithm and simulated annealing, brings forward a genetic clonal annealing algorithm and applied to solve grid computing task scheduling problem. From the analysis and experiment result, it is concluded that this algorithm is superior to genetic algorithm and simulated annealing.

articleTitle: Improved method to compress JPEG based on patent
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Compression ratio of lossless compression algorithm for image is poor. A patent which can be lossless compression methods combined by shuffle algorithm and lossless compression algorithm is introduced in the paper and proposes a improved novel algorithm based on patent. Combining new algorithm and universal lossless compression algorithm showed that this method can further remove the internal documents redundancy and reduce the file size.

articleTitle: Study and application of web data mining based on XML
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: With the development of information technologies, web data mining has been put forward and in wide research. It is defined as the discovery, extraction and analysis of useful and potential information from the World Wide Web. But much of inhomogeneous and anomalistic and dynamic updated semi-structured data in web pages makes web data mining difficult. To solve this problem, on the basis of analyzing the characteristics of XML, the paper presents a web data mining model on XML, and introduces the method to implement the model with XML and Java technologies in detail with the combination of an instance. Finally, some valuable discussions are put forward on this model for its shortages.

articleTitle: Naïve Bayes Associative classification of mammographic data
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In this paper we focus on a new model, named ANB (Associative Naïve Bayes) model. ANB model extend the modeling flexibility of well known Naïve Bayes (NB) models by introducing rules generated by associative classifier. The model consists of two layers: an input layer and an internal layer. We propose an associative classifier algorithm (AAC), relaxing the condition of independence of attributes in NB, for generating rules and learning network parameter and a simple algorithm for training ANB models in the context of classification. Experimental results show that the learned models can significantly improve classification accuracy as compared to NB.

articleTitle: A new method of smoke simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In this paper, a multiscale fluid model based on Navier-Stokes is proposed, and the operator splitting method is employed to split the model into advection term, diffusion term, external force term and projection term. Every step is stable, so the whole process is also stable. The idea of using particle system to modify the Navier-Stokes equations was raised. And at the same time, “vorticity confinement” is used to enhance the real-time simulation. Compared with the traditional technique, this method can be taken for realistic animation and real-time simulation for smoke in two-dimensional space.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A communication platform for teaching based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Fault management of computer networks based on probe station selection algorithms
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: We addressed the problem of probe station selection in order to monitor the network for detecting and localizing node failures. We presented a systematic reduction of the Minimum Probe Station Selection problem to the Minimum Hitting Set problem and presented an algorithm for probe station selection. We then demonstrated how the proposed approach can be modified to address link failures and probe station failures. We presented experimental evaluation of the proposed algorithm for various network configurations to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: The relations and interactions of E-government and e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: E-government (EG) and e-commerce (EC) are the most important fields of the applications of Information Highway in days of global informationization, so the development in harmony with each other is especially important. This thesis discusses the relations and interactions between E-government & e-commerce from the leading role of E-government and its link with e-commerce.

articleTitle: A secure method on a routing protocol for ad hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Ad hoc network is collections of wireless mobile devices with limited broadcast range and resources, and no fixed infrastructure. Routing issue is one of the most basic networking issues in ad hoc network. An adversary can easily palsy the network by attacking the routing protocol. There are some secure routing protocols have been proposed for ad hoc network. In this paper is argued about the flaws in an ad hoc routing protocol that called Ariadne. This paper shows that the security proof for the route discovery algorithm Ariadne is flawed, and moreover, this algorithm is vulnerable to some attacks. For solving the shortages in this protocol is proposed the method in the route discovery algorithm. Proposed method in this paper adds the ability of the malicious node detections to this protocol.

articleTitle: Devices for developing course video resources on the basis of low energy consumption
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Schools typically consume significant amounts of energy. Analyses of the existing processes of developing course video resources as well as the devices used in these processes suggest that there is a potential to reduce energy consumption. Examinations of the tasks of developing course video resources show that more resources are developed than what is needed for real-time remote education, and that the devices used in the processes have more functions than necessary, resulting in wastage of energy. Thus, there is a need to design low energy-consuming devices to develop course video resources; such devices will require less than one fifth of the energy consumed by devices currently in use. And energy conservation requirements are also proposed for the design of low energy consuming devices. IT firms may design such devices on the basis of these requirements. With such devices, schools will be able to develop course video resources while contributing to the preservation of the environment and the conservation of natural resources.

Author Keywords: Devices for Developing Course Video Resources

articleTitle: A study of ship integrated navigation system risk assessment based on fuzzy analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: The risk assessment is an important means to obtain the status of system security and an important basis to develop security solutions as well. Taking the integrated navigation system as the research object, this article establishes the risk assessment index system based on the analysis of the composition and the characteristic foundation of the integrated navigation system, carrying on the assessment with the combination of qualitative and quantitative analysis through improved fuzzy AHP system and verifying with examples. The analysis shows that it is a practical method to certain extent.

articleTitle: Impact of non academic websites usage on female students academic performance (a case study)
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Recently all or most of the academic institutions have made substantial investment in computing and building internet infrastructure with an objective to improve productivity of students and faculty members. However non academic websites are dominantly using and social networking sites are becoming extremely popular for internet users especially for college students.

articleTitle: A flexible computer based assessment system that uses flash disk
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In this paper we introduce the use of a Computer Based Assessment (CBA) system; discuss the functionality, usability and reliability of the system. The system has a simple and user-friendly interface, and it just executes a program on a stand-alone computer or on an online computer without changing hardware or software. It can be used for mid-term or final exam in small-scale for many courses. The teacher can change the question bank as his own idea by using word processing software. To avoid students copying each other, all the questions display in random sequence. The question files and the answer sheet file are encrypted for delivering, so it can reduce cheating. It is a helpful tool for teachers. It can also be used for student's self-assessment, as when they finish the assessment, the system may feedback the score immediately. The practice shows that the student is very interested in using the CBA system.

articleTitle: Warfighting simulation system for system effectiveness analysis of Hypersonic Cruise Missile
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Recent efforts on warfighting simulation systemfor predicting system effectiveness of Hypersonic Cruise Missile(HCM) are reviewed in this paper. The focus of this workis to develop an M&S environment as an effectiveness analysis tool for statistical analyzing outputs from warfighting simulation under prescribed engagement scenario. Prior to the engagement simulation, a effectiveness analysis framework with four abstract levels and three operators is established to represent the M&S process and properties of HCM. High fidelity models of HCM and anti-missile defence systems are established with an interactive modeling environment and then run in the simulation platform based on HLA. Finally, the system effectiveness of HCM is evaluated by statistical method from the outputs from a number of “One on One”, Monte Carlo, engagement simulation experiments for a typical scenario.

articleTitle: Design for dual-front axle steering angle of the heavy truck
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: The relationship between the one-axis angle and two of front axle heavy truck steering mechanism is studied. Based on characteristics of steering and Ackerman theorem, the reasonable objective function is used to build. The steering mechanism is designed by the grid method. The design method is reasonable and effective. The research results can be used as a reference for the design of the steering mechanism of other multi-axle vehicle.

articleTitle: Implementation of the load balancing for multiple VPN server
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This paper proposes a load balancing algorithm for multiple VPN equipments. According to the history flow data of each business node in a period, our algorithm calculates its statistical estimated flow, which is approximate to the real value. And then specifies a special server as a scheduling server. If a business node requests a VPN connection, first, it should communicate with the scheduling server. The scheduling server computed the current load of each VPN server, determines the VPN server the business node should connect, response the request business node with the VPN server's IP address. Finally, the node establishes a connection with the VPN server. Our algorithm not only considers the VPN server's own load condition but also the request business node's flow fluctuations, trying best to avoid the situation that different nodes' flow peak values superimpose in one VPN server at a special time. The experimental results show that our load balancing algorithm improves utilization rate as a whole; at the same time, it avoids the situation that in a period some of the VPN servers overload while others are in the idle condition.

articleTitle: Domain concept extraction algorithm based on Semantic Web Ontology learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: The Semantic Web Ontology learning technology introduced is to reduce the overall time of ontology construction. Ontology construction process includes several aspects, and extraction domain concept is one of the most important aspects. In this paper, we proposed a domain concept extraction algorithm. The algorithm aims at improving the extraction efficiency and accuracy of domain concepts, thereby enhancing the efficiency of building the entire ontology. We have achieved integrating personalized recommendation technology and concept extraction technology into a coherent whole, and more accurately and efficiently finished extracting domain concepts. Through the analysis of the results gained from the experiment proved the feasibility of the algorithm.

articleTitle: An efficient heuristic control algorithm for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Since the energy supply of a sensor node is limited, energy optimization should be considered as the key objective when studying the wireless sensor networks (WSNs). Our contribution is in integrated control optimization and genetic algorithms to ensure proper function of WSNs in extremely limited bandwidth, power and storage. A set of simulation results are performed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has higher efficiency and can achieve better network lifetime at the base station.

articleTitle: The design of disabled people assistant
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Recent results on the design of a set of electric wheelchair system for the disabled and the elderly are presented in this paper. This system could be controlled by either touching screen or human voice. The equipment for physiological index detecting is installed on the wheelchair, it can indicate the health level of people. By touching the screen on the wheelchair, you can make a phone call, control all domestic appliances and achieve other fanny intelligent functions. This system can create a safe, intelligent, easy and fashionable environment for the users. This system has been applied in practice and has achieved a good result.

articleTitle: Research on gompertz curve model used for mobile user growth
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This paper deals with the application of gompertz curve model to mobile user growth. gompertz growth curve is a kind of product life cycle theories, which reveals the development of product markets has a sigmoid growing process. The gompertz curve model which can be transformed, employ ordinary least-squares principle to simply formula. Based on historical data, the initial formula can be projected. In order to achieve better prediction accuracy,0.618 optimal seeking methods can be employed to optimize Model ,which adjusts limit parameters of gompertz growth curve for the purpose of fitting actual data. Although the gompertz model establishment for Postal and Telecommunication Services is demonstrated in this paper, this model can be applied in many fields. Example programs for specifying these models based on the use of the gompertz Curve Model are also provided. So the gompertz model is effective path to the research of product life cycle theories, which the prospect of application will be promising.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Optimal model and non-linear rectification method based on annealing-inspired genetic algorithm in sensors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Five components automobile exhaust measurement system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This paper describes the measurement principle of vehicle exhaust, system configuration and design of hardware and software systems. A combination measurement method of non-spectrophotometric infrared measurement and electrochemical measurement is propoased. Five components in the exhaust, which are carbon monoxide (CO), hydrocarbons (HC), carbon dioxide (CO2), nitrogen oxides (NO), and oxygen (O2), are measured accurately.

articleTitle: A method to improve the management of multimedia classrooms
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Multimedia classroom as an effective teaching facilities, is still the mainstream application mode of e-education technology in Chinese campus. However, to manage computer installed in multimedia classroom is a rather annoying problem. In this paper, we propose a solution named NVClassroom, to combine the advantages of non-disk and virtualization technology. NVClassroom can significantly reduce the cost of computer failures and maintenance, also meet individual requirements of teachers.

articleTitle: Evaluating service quality of the subject librarian based on fuzzy variable
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Evaluation on subject librarian service quality is the key step to get a better subject librarian service quality and obtain consumers' satisfaction. In this paper, a new approach, which is based on fuzzy variable, analytical hierarchy process and entropy method, is proposed to deal with the problem of the subject librarian service quality evaluation. Case study is provided to illustrate the implementation and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Use of advanced computer-aided biomodels in practical orthopaedic education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Advanced computer-aided biomodels are essential for orthopaedic surgery and its medical education. In the present study, three-dimensional (3D) real size physical models manufactured by rapid prototyping (RP) technology together with high resolution 3D digital reconstruction images under control of CAD were used in clinical orthopedics. Besides, these computer-based modern biomodels were also utilized in the practical orthopaedic education. As a result, optimal preoperative planning for complex fracture cases was worked out and performed clinically. Subsequently, the surgical outcomes were markedly improved and good results in medical education for orthopaedic residents and junior doctors were obtained. Roles of the advanced computer-aided biomodels in orthopaedic surgery and its practical medical education were explored in this study.

articleTitle: Study on control system for vice-steering device of training car
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: The training car's vice-steering device and its operating schematic are introduced. Fuzzy-PID control algorithm is chose according to its working characters and the control circuit is designed. The validity and feasibility are proved by simulation and experiment results.

articleTitle: Exact traveling wave solution For Kadomtsev-Petviashvili equation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In this paper, we derive exact traveling wave solutions of Kadomtsev-Petviashvili equation by a presented method. The method appears to be efficient in seeking exact solutions of nonlinear equations.

articleTitle: A Software solution for a Mathematical Model of Professor Efficacy Parameters
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: During recent years much significant progress has been made in the research of different aspects of university education. Various methods, techniques, approaches and learning concepts related to research in this area have been developed. It is undoubtedly that in the entire educational process one of the central places is occupied by teachers. In accordance with this role, there is an implicit effect to the quality of teachers on the quality of graduates. There are many attributes on which we could define the quality of teachers - among other things there are academic title, experience, number of courses that one professor could teach, personal traits - charisma, etc. Bearing in mind these parameters of teachers quality, in this study we defined Professor Efficacy Parameter, which represent a numerical display of academic ability of each teacher individually. In this paper we present a Software solution for the Mathematical Model of Professor Efficacy Parameters.

articleTitle: Exploration on personnel training for regional game industry development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This paper analyzes the development of the game recreation industry of Zhongshan City, as well as the teaching conditions of the local independent institute, based on which some explorations on the modes of nurturing talents for game specialty are made. First, the objective of personnel training for game specialty is claimed to be fostering the compound talents with the abilities of creative design and application development. Then the construction of the professional curriculum is discussed accordingly, and a multi-level curriculum is presented which consists of foundation courses, professional core courses and electives. Besides, the teaching contents and methods reform of some correlative courses are probed. Finally, the platform building for the practice training is also studied in detail.

articleTitle: Development of multichannel parameter test system in wood drying kiln based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This paper discussed the design of automatic measuring system in wood drying kiln using DSP as a MCU. Meanwhile, in order to improve detection accuracy of the drying kiln's parameters, we analyzed and selected the sensor for the detection, and proposed ways to improve the detection accuracy. Experimental results show that the system is stable, high accuracy, and reliable in real-time data acquisition. The accuracy of temperature measurement is ± 0.5°C. The accuracy of equilibrium moisture content and wood moisture content is± 3%.

articleTitle: Image fusion at pixel level algorithm is introduced and the evaluation criteria
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This paper introduces the concept of the image fusion technology and its division level. Image fusion by the different levels of information abstraction can be divided into three levels: Pixel-level fusion, Feature-level fusion and Decision-level fusion. It reviews the image fusion at pixel level technology and probes into the form of image fusion method of evaluation criteria. At last it gives the development direction of image fusion.

articleTitle: The study on security issues in imprecise databases based on rough set theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: We have shown how the nature of the rough relational database provides some inherent security through its use of non-first normal form structure. Moreover, we provided measures of database security based on information-theoretic measures that allow for the evaluation of numeric measures for entropy. We are currently investigating the extension of this work for fuzzy rough and intuitionist relational databases.

articleTitle: A mobile wireless sensor networks prediction algorithm based on clustering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This paper researches the problem of energy efficient optimization for the measurement of wireless sensor nodes. Based on Clustering, the metric of network measurement coverage and communicate energy consumption are established. In this paper, we propose a Distributed Clustering Algorithm (DCA) which is based on the use of predicted combined criteria metric. In DCA algorithm, the sensor calculates its combined criteria metric according to connectivity, coverage, mobility and residual energy, after that each sensor node uses its history combined criteria information to predict the current combined criteria based on heuristic predictors. Our proposed algorithm uses adequate criterion for cluster-head election in conjunction with heuristic predictors to generate steady and balanced clusters. The simulation experiments show that comparing to existed algorithm, the network measurement coverage is getting higher and the communicate energy consumption is getting lower.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The research of GPS localization and Map-Matching method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A novel self-organizing quantum evolutionary algorithm for multi-objective optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In this study, a self-organizing quantum evolutionary algorithm for multi-objective optimization (MSQEA) is proposed. Because of the quantum dynamic mechanism all the subpopulations may move concurrently in a force-field until all of them reach their equilibrium states. We estimate the performance of algorithm. The efficiency of the approach has been illustrated by applying to 0/1 Multi-objective knapsack problems. The results show that MSQEA can yield improvement in solution quality.

articleTitle: Digital tools for material selection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Finite Element Analysis (FEA) of functionally material objects are generally regarded as separate domains of interest in CAD and Computer-Aided Engineering (CAE) community. With CAD modeling tools only,the end users are still uncertain whether or not the designed objects can really meet the functional requirements in terms of structural, thermal or other prescribed properties. Considering the main factors with important influence on material paramaters, the support vector machine (SVM) model is established, which can really meet the functional requirements in terms of structural, thermal or other prescribed properties. Taking surving data investigating the relationships that exist between the structures and properties of materials, as samples for training and learning, some functions are obtained in identification of optimized model. It is shown that the identification model of SVM analysis is an effective method with high prediction accuracy and could be used in practice.

articleTitle: A class of similarity measures between vague sets and its applications to pattern recognition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: The properties of (t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">u</inf>, f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">u</inf>) expand of a vague value have been discussed, and a class of similarity measures between vague sets based on the three-dimensional representation has been presented in this paper. An example applied to pattern recognition shows that these formulas are practicable.

articleTitle: Exploration and research on the education method of college students' information literacy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This paper starts from the awareness of information literacy, analyzing the research value of the education for students' information literacy. And it makes some exploration and research on the education methods of college students' information literacy.

articleTitle: Multimedia courseware design of real-time computing power based on Powerpoint and MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In order to easily realize real-time computing power of multimedia courseware of PowerPoint, a multimedia courseware design method of is presented. This method designs the courseware based on the technology combining PowerPoint and MATLAB. This technology can realize data exchange of PowerPoint and MATLAB by ActiveX automation. By this technology, data of PowerPoint can sent to MATLAB workspace, complex calculation is completed by MATLAB, and then calculated data sent back PowerPoint again. Practice demonstrates that multimedia courseware designed by this technology has real-time computing power, friendly user interface, good interaction and its programming is very simple.

articleTitle: Analysis of single-phase pulsating-flow hydraulic control system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: The efficiency and pressure shock of pulsating-flow hydraulic system always restrict the application of the technology in engineering. In order to study the system characteristics, a single-phase pulsating-flow hydraulic experimental platform is designed, and the transfer function, stability of closed-loop response characteristics and system error are analyzed in detail.

articleTitle: Application research of a Statistical Regression Algorithm in the IVR system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This paper proposes a Statistical Regression Algorithm, According to the number of node visited, it generates the dynamic menu of the IVR (Interactive Voice Response) system. The algorithm is implemented through IVR application gateway which is very important for the IVR system. The voice files of data demanded are built and played for response through application gateway, TTS (Text to Speech) and IVR server together. The weakness of poor scalability of the IVR is fixed and the load of IVR is reduced, and the reliability of IVR is improved through this Algorithm.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study of economic benefit evaluation based on integrity management mode
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Simulation heat transmission mechanism of insulation material by finite element method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: An identity-based signature scheme with public key recovery
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In this paper, a new authentication mechanism is proposed, which reverses the protocol validation process into biometrics recognition to resolve uncertainty in the biometric data under the conditions of the inherent fault-tolerance in a variety of biometric technologies. The new signature scheme presented in this paper is based on the elliptic curve discrete logarithm problem (ECDLP) and large integer factorization that gives public key recovery. It combines an identity-based signature scheme and a signature scheme based on elliptic curve giving message recovery. Using the challenge-response mechanism, it can resist eavesdropping and replay attacks on the network. Finally, we analyze the security of our presented scheme.

articleTitle: Study on computer systems framework of bridge maintenance and strengthening
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This paper studied the systematic application norms and load test assessment standards which gave evaluation to the damaging status and carrying capacity of the bridge by establishing data model and decision-making data model through the collected data. Moreover, it put forward damaging causes and decision-making measures through Delphi method.

articleTitle: A method of keywords selection evaluation based on search volume
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: A comprehensive keywords evaluation method based on keywords' search volume is introduced in this paper. According to the fluctuations in keywords search volume and the comparison with relevant keywords, a more scientific and simpler way of selecting keywords based on the search volume could be found by determining the appropriate keywords as the optimization target using composite index evaluation method.

articleTitle: Solid state culture for immobilization of Bacillus marinus cells bound intracelluar lipase within biomass support particles
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Solid state fermentation (SSF) was used to cultivate Bacillus marinus on particles of polyurethane foam impregnated with suitable medium for immobilization of bound intracellular lipase within polyurethane biomass support particles (BSPs). Compared with the free dried cell, the intracellular lipase activity of the immobilized cell in BSPs was increased from 680.2 Unit per gram of dried cells to 968.5U/g cells. This is the first report on the cultivation of Bacillus marinus in solid state culture for immobilization of lipase in BSPs.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research of GPS/DR integrated position system in position of navigation marks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Finite element simulation of machining of Incoloy 907 with thermodynamical constitutive equation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In this paper a finite element analysis (FEA) of machining for Incoloy 907 is presented. In particular, the thermodynamical constitutive equation(T-C-E) in FEA is applied for both workpiece material and tool material. Cutting temperature and tool wear depth are predicted. The comparison between the predicted and experimental cutting temperature and tool wear depth are presented and discussed. The results indicated that a good prediction accuracy of both principal cutting temperature and tool wear depth can be achieved by the method of FEA with thermodynamical constitutive equation.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Dynamic analysis of forest biomass in Changbai Mountain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on domain ontology semi-automatic construction model towards Chinese text
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: As the in-depth study of ontology, various areas are also gradually expanded in the application of ontology, therefore the construction of domain ontology has become the bottleneck of ontology extension and application. In addition, because of the complexity of Chinese in natural language processing (NLP), the construction study of domain ontology for Chinese description is also slow. For the shortcomings of hand-construct ontology, a semi-automatic construction model of domain ontology towards Chinese text is proposed, which improves the automation and speed of ontology construction through the cycle of improvement and updating to the initial seed ontology, and also provides the basis protection for the in-depth study of domain ontology.

articleTitle: Hypersonic vehicle wing-body joint location design optimization basing on Hybrid Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: The wing-body joint location is key step in aircraft design which has close relationship with the balancing, maneuverability and stability, hiding ability. In this paper, aiming at the wing-body joint location of quasi-waverider hypersonic vehicle, improving on the Simple Genetic Algorithms(SGA), inducting the simulated annealing algorithm (SAA), the Hybrid Genetic Algorithm (HGA) comes into being. Optimizing the wing-body joint location with the HGA, getting the Pareto optimal solution, the best configuration is recommended. Comparing with the basic model configuration, the recommended configuration improves in the balancing, maneuverability and stability, hiding ability.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: PID- Fuzzy control research on hydraulic semi-active suspension system of car
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An improved self-learning model based on network environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Stiffness analysis of pre-loaded hollow cylindrical roller bearings based on ABAQUS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Stiffness is an important parameter of pre-loaded hollow cylindrical roller bearing, but the traditional theory is not fit for this highly nonlinear problem. In order to find out the impact of hollow-ratio, interference magnitude and load on pre-loaded hollow cylindrical roller bearing's stiffness, a kind of modern analysis software named ABAQUS was used to create the finite element model. The analysis results show that: the stiffness of pre-loaded hollow cylindrical roller bearing becomes small with the addition of roller's hollow-ratio, and the variation is significant; the stiffness of pre-loaded hollow cylindrical roller bearing goes up with the increase of load and interference magnitude, but the gradients is small. The results provide reference for the design of pre-loaded hollow cylindrical roller bearing.

articleTitle: Some classical constructive neural networks and their new developments
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Reviewing old ones is to better understand new ones and also for innovating. The mapping capability of artificial neural networks is dependent on their structure, i.e., the number of layers and the number of hidden units. Presently, there is no formal way of computing network topology as a function of the complexity of a problem; it is usually selected by trial-and-error and can be rather time consuming. Basically, we make use of two mechanisms that may modify the topology of the network: growth and pruning. This paper firstly discusses some learning algorithms and topologies of classical constructive neural networks. Only incremental or growing algorithms employing supervised learning algorithms are outlined here which includes Tiling algorithm, Tower algorithm, Upstart algorithm, Cascade-Correlation algorithm, Restricted coulomb energy network and Resource-allocation network. For each neural network model, we review their topology structure and learning features. The new development of constructive neural networks is given at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Project trend on coastal wetland change and prediction Tupu models
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on multi-object clonal genetic algorithm for the 0-1 knapsack
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Immune clonal algorithm (ICA) is applied to genetic algorithm (GA) to develop a class of multi-object clonal genetic algorithm (MOCGA) for combinatorial optimization. With the condition of preserving simulated annealing advantages, MOCGA takes advantage of ICA algorithm so as to avoid premature convergence. To demonstrate its effectiveness and applicability, experiments are carried out on the 0-1 knapsack problem. The results show that MOCGA performs well, without premature convergence as compared to GA.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on a distributed intelligent framework based on semantics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The low-power design and application of single chip system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: The paper attempts to elaborate system low-power design methods in microcontroller, peripheral circuits and system software, etc., on the basis of the working features of microcontroller and the CMOS circuits. At last, the author discusses the low-power design in details by taking the examples of optical fiber identifier. Practice shows that it can significantly reduce system power consumption and extend battery life after considering that consumption in the design.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On the culture teaching of College English from the cognitive perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Influence of SMAX on bandwidth utilization for ControlNet
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: The ControlNet is a high speed and deterministic network. It has been developed by Rockwell Automation. The ControlNet network's mission is to provide reliable, high-speed transport of two basic types of application information: control and I/O data; non-time critical messaging data related to the controlled system. This is accomplished by partitioning the bandwidth into a scheduled portion that is guaranteed to be delivered within a specified Network Update Time and a unscheduled portion that is essentially the time remaining after the scheduled traffic is handled. A parameter for ControlNet is scheduled max node (SMAX). In this article, we studied the parameter of the ControlNet network when used in a control situation. Simulation results and conclusions are presented.

articleTitle: Prediction of fiber diameter on spunbonding fabric using neural network and physical model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Two modeling methods (physical model, and artificial neural network model) are developed to predict the fiber diameter of spunbonding nonwovens. By analyzing the results of two models, the effects of process parameters on fiber diameter can be predicted. The results show the artificial neural network model can yield more accurate and stable predictions than the physical model, and it can yield reasonably good prediction results and provide insight into the relationship between process parameters and fiber diameter. At the same time, the experimental results and the corresponding analysis also show that the neural network is an efficient technique for the quality prediction.

articleTitle: Next Generation Network design and capacity dimensioning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Next Generation Network NGN Internet protocol (IP)-centric converged network aims to provide a multitude of services over a single integrated network infrastructure, rather than multiple separated and overlay networks, as have existed for decades. The deployment of NGN have brought unique challenges in how to deploy and dimensioning NGN to meet uncertain market demands of the new bandwidth hungry services with minimum cost. Building NGN network should pass through the three main phases, Network Planning, Designing, and Expansion. This paper will present a precisely method based on mathematics criteria to calculate the essential needed resources and equipments for NGN deployment in the three different phases. This method aims to reduce the capital expenditure (CAPEX) by determining the optimal quantities of equipments that meet the high grade of services requirements. Implementing this method to calculate the needed resources to migrate Yemen Telecom (YT) network to NGN will be also presented.

articleTitle: On communication platform for teaching based on virtual instrument
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Virtual instrument software LabVIEW is a graphical programming language characterized by easy to be read and understood. So it is suitable for teaching difficult theoretical kinds of courses. Communication theory is a theoretical course and its many concepts are abstract. To solve the problems of hard to learn and teach the course, a teaching platform for communication theory was built by virtual instrument development tools-LabVIEW in this paper. The platform covers the main contents of the course and demonstrates communication systems animatedly. The novel platform provides a new way for teaching and more resources for campus web. Take band-pass digital communication system for example,2ASK(Amplitude shift keying) modulation and demodulation simulation system is established.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Constitution and optimization of the car industry integrated supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Development of control system of automatic leaf spring end eye forming machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: The automatic leaf spring end eye forming machine is special equipment which is used for the trimming (or corner cutting) and end eye forming of leaf-spring. The control system and program has been developed. The Centralized control mode has been adopted by PLC in the machine. The control system software construction is the modular program type. Equipped with Electro-hydraulic servo-driven hydraulic cylinder and sensor with the properties of high precision and good linearity, all performing structures in the machine could locate and move and work in precision status. The control program of PLC could complete real-time controlling and testing in the machine form the leaf spring into and out furnace, trimming (or corner cutting), end eye forming to finished product palletization.

articleTitle: Weakly complementary cycles in a class of multipartite tournaments
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: The problem of complementary cycles in tournaments and bipartite tournaments was completely solved. However, the problem of complementary cycles in semicomplete n -partite digraphs with n ≥3 is still open. Based on the definition of weakly complementary cycles, we get the following result. Let D be a 2 -strong n -partite tournament that is not a tournament, where n ≥6 . Let C be a 3 -cycle of D and D-V(C) be nonstrong. For the unique acyclic sequence D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>,D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>,..., D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">α</sub> of D-V(C), where α≥2 , if 1 |V(D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">α+1-i</sub>)|= 1, D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> contains cycles for i = 1 or i = α, then D contains a pair of weakly complementary cycles.

articleTitle: Application of knowledge management in public administration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In this paper, to achieve organizational goals and objectives, ways of how public organizations manage knowledge, their largest single asset, are introduced and five unique properties of knowledge are described as an introduction to the context of knowledge management. With examples from public organization, knowledge management is defined and different roles of man, technology, processes and organizational structure are presented. It is concluded with a description of the benefits of knowledge management (KM) to individuals, communities of practice and public organizations.

articleTitle: A novel learning algorithm inspired by the concept of DNA sequence in biological systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In this paper, a novel algorithm named DNA-like learning algorithm is proposed. This algorithm is enable to quickly train the CNN template implementing LSBF, and has many advantages including without the need to consider its convergence property, in particular faster running speed and better robustness. The important problem of implementing non-LSBF will be further discussed in the future study.

articleTitle: Demonstration software for digital image processing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This paper presents a new demonstration software environment for teaching Digital Image Processing (DIP), and illustrates how it can facilitate teaching some key concepts and algorithms in DIP. This software is developed with VC during the process of our teaching DIP in an application-oriented college. It comprises abundant functions to demonstrate concepts and algorithms in the course and some other functions to assist in case-based teaching. The graphical user interface is user-friendly and the parameter control is versatile, so that the software can also act as a platform for students to perform experiments and verifications. With the aid of this software, vivid demonstrations can be conducted directly in class, which greatly advances teaching effects.

articleTitle: Design of the Web-based monitoring system architecture for geomagnetically induced current
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: When magnetic storm occured, the magnetic field fluctuations generated geomagnetically-induced currents (GIC) on the power grid. Monitoring and analysis for GIC become a new important topic. In this paper, we gave the design of the Web-based monitoring system architecture for geomagnetically-induced current, which based on the study of the developed monitoring device for GIC, by combining the technology of computer, network and communication, and the application of ASP.NET. This paper elaborates key technology in the system architecture, such as ComponentOne WebChart and Ajax.

articleTitle: Study on enterprise price risk management system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: An enterprise price risk management system is designed and studied to manage and control price risk in futures market. The whole structure and function model of the system is introduced. Through correlation analysis of futures and spot price, the system can help enterprise to adjust production business plan, furthermore to make purchase inventory sales plan. This is an effective application of staple commodities futures and spot price based on correlation analysis.

articleTitle: Load balance controlling algorithm on unstructured P2P Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: To find hubs correctly on unstructured P2P network, considering different ability for different nodes, this paper imported load degree for nodes and takes nodes possessing high load degree as heavy ones, then proposed a balance control algorithm, in which loads from heavy nodes transfer to light ones. From simulation, this algorithm can equal efficiently loads from different nodes, especially for nodes from activity peer-to-peer network.

articleTitle: A new predictive PID control algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In order to resolve the lack of predictive ability in traditional PID controller, a new predictive PID controller is present: at each sample time, through the error between current measured value and set value, the output of next step is predicted, and an adjustment is made. In the simulated example of two-order tank control system, the controller effect of predictive PID controller is much better than traditional PID controller.

articleTitle: Re-ranking algorithm using clustering and relevance feedback for image retrieval
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In conventional content-based image retrieval (CBIR) systems, it is often observed that images visually dissimilar to a query image are ranked high in retrieval results, which affects the retrieval effectiveness. To remedy this problem, we re-rank the retrieved images via clustering and relevance feedback. Based on conventional CBIR system, the retrieved images are analyzed using clustering method, and the weights of each feature component are updated. Then, the rank of the results is adjusted according to the distance of a cluster from a query. Experimental results show that our re-ranking algorithm achieves a more rational ranking of retrieval results compared with existing methods.

articleTitle: Mission assignment approach of team service robots based on evolutionary algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This work is the first step in the development of a centralized decision making agent for the IWARD project that is the extension of two difficult problems VRP-TW and the MC-VRP combined together. In this paper we presented the problem and proposed a resolution method using the evolutionary algorithms. Improving the local search algorithms and the crossover techniques, taking into account the mission duration, not only the order of the missions would be important avenues for future improvements, but also the variation of the parameters mainly the mutation factor and population sizes could be also beneficial.

articleTitle: Rough data and applications of rough data law
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: S-rough sets (singular rough sets) theory was proposed by improving Z. Pawlak rough sets theory. S-rough sets have dynamic characteristics, since it is defined by R-element equivalence class [x] which has dynamic characteristic. The concept of rough data was presented by employing S-rough sets, and rough data has dynamic characteristic, furthermore, the rough data law generation is given. Based on the concepts above, the generation theorem and the reversion theorem of rough data law, the recognition criterion of rough data law, and the discernible theorem of rough data law were given, finally the applications of rough data law in risk investment system are presented.

Author Keywords: dual of one direction S-rough sets

articleTitle: Exact traveling wave solution For NLS+ equation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In this paper, we derive exact traveling wave solutions of NLS+ by a presented method. The method appears to be efficient in seeking exact solutions of nonlinear equations.

articleTitle: A dynamic scheduling model oriented to flexible production
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: To optimize scheduling pertaining to two production units and many tasks in flexible production, a dynamic scheduling model was proposed, considering capacity balance. Each production unit was modeled as a kind of container whose capacity symbolized the throughout. The capacity was divided as planned and spared parts. Joining spared capacities in two units, the state-to-art dynamic scheduling rules were created according to hydro-mechanical theory. A practical heuristic algorithm was developed for this model. The model was tested as feasible and effective in a case study conducted at an actual business.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Program design of financial management skill system based on evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Teaching software design of particles size measurement with mircoscope image
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In order to make the student easily understand the particles measurement principles of microscope image and cooperate with the theory teaching and practical teaching of this technology. A set of software design which set theory teaching and practical teaching in one is given. This particles measurement software was designed by GUI of MATLAB. It can successfully calculate the size and number of particles by some image process. The software has the features with easy operability, friendly user interface. Practice demonstrates that the effect of teaching is improved, the quality of software program and the practical application ability of students are enhanced, and the teaching target of combining theory with practice is achieved by this software. At the same time, learning interest of student is also increased.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The study of expert system in rolling bearing faults diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Teaching research and practice of Basic Computer Course for Postgraduates
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Nowadays basic computer education is an indispensable compulsory course for postgraduates. Based on the present status and our experience of the teaching of Basic Computer Course for Postgraduates, I'd like to give several pieces of advice in this article in order to improve the teaching environment and quality.

articleTitle: Anisotropic diffusion based weed classifier
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This paper presents a new approach of anisotropic diffusion to classify the weed images into broad and narrow class for real time selective herbicide application The classifier we proposed based on Perona and Malik equation. Its low computational complexity and fast runtimes makes this method well suited for real-time vision applications. The developed system has been tested on weeds in the lab; the results show a very reliable performance and drastically less computational effort on images of weeds taken under varying field conditions. The analysis of the results shows over 97.6% classification accuracy over 200 sample images.

articleTitle: An application interactive platform integrating applications with OpenAPI into campus network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In this paper we describe a platform to integrate Web applications which has OpenAPIs into campus network, to provide the users of campus network with services through the external web applications. We analyse the key problem when integrating the Web applications with OpenAPIs taking the Online Office APIs for example, and summarize the API's feature that can be integrated by the platform.

articleTitle: The process of designing and developing a Romanised Mandarin web-based instruction on ISD methodology for non-native learners in Malaysia
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: One of the ways to deliver a language course on learners' demand using any computer connected to the Internet at anywhere and anytime is by developing a Web-based instruction (WBI). Besides, it can be more effective if WBI incorporates multimedia components. ‘A picture tells a thousand words’, thus, a Mandarin WBI that includes multimedia elements will increase the effectiveness in learning Mandarin. The objective of this paper is to describe the process of designing and developing a Hanyu Pinyin (Romanised Mandarin) WBI to teach non-native learners (Malay Mandarin learners) in learning Mandarin at a Malaysian university(UiTM). The Hanyu Pinyin WBI is tailored to tackle the weaknesses and to meet the specific needs of Malay learners. Hanyu Pinyin WBI is designed on the basis of Instructional System Design (ISD) methodology. This approach involves four phases: (1) analysis and design, (2) development, (3) implementation, and (4) evaluation of the instruction.

articleTitle: Least-squares finite element for nonlinear MHD equations
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: The stationary motion of magnetic force to conductive fluid could get nonlinear MHD equations, and mathematical analysis for the flow of MHD is very complex. In order to solve this kind of special problems, least-squares finite element method is put forward to solve nonlinear MHD equations: firstly, give least-squares form, and then testify the existence and convergence of solution. From the theory analysis, we could know that for nonlinear MHD equations, least-squares finite element method could obtain optimal error estimation.

articleTitle: Importance of information technology education course in the process of traning information literacy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Information literacy is an ability to adapt to the information society, which involves information consciousness, information capability and information application. Today with the rapid development of information technology, the course of information technology plays a growing role in training information literacy. Based on this fact, this paper will do some research and study.

articleTitle: The application of UMA technology in communication network teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: UMA is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) global standard for subscriber access to mobile circuit, packet and IMS-based services over any IP-based access network. This paper analyzes the potential disadvantages of traditional communication network teaching and proposes an approach to setup simulated mobile network using UMA technology. In this simulated mobile network, we can make a call, send short message via WiFi network. Students can find out what happen when a call is made and write programs to simulate MS(mobile station) on this platform. It will help students to understand the principles of communication network better.

articleTitle: Exploration and research on teaching of basic computer course in higher vocational college
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Last semester, I undertook the basic computer course of higher vocational students in the institute of long distance education and further education college, during which I made some analysis and research on the existing problems of basic computer course in higher vocational college and some exploration and practice at the aspect of teaching reform.

Author Keywords: basic computer course in higher vocational college

publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Computer-mediated collaborative learning in management education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This article introduces a conceptual framework for understanding the role of computer-mediated interaction and investigates whether the students participate General Management Case Analysis (GMCA) used computer-mediated collaborative learning method enhances student learning ability. The final management skills test of students who had participated GMCA used computer-mediated collaborative learning method were significantly higher than those of the other group of students who hadn't participated.

articleTitle: The analysis of the solitary wave evolutional characters with Matlab
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In the paper, we implement the pseudo-spectral method with Matlab software, and researched the evolutional characters of the solitary wave described by fKdV equation. Matlab has been a good one in numerical computation and simulation and it has been widely used in hydrodynamics and applied mathematics. Many complicated engineering problem can be solved by Matlab, At last, the waterfall plot of the equation is showed. And it is convenience to program with the Matlab for the pseudo-spectral method for the PDE equation.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Culture input in college English teaching in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The method of cluster and entropy apply in city distribution center location
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: As a junction of city logistics system, the reasonable location of city distribution center plays a great significance. To some extent, some common schemes of location are not application of the city distribution center as today's city has its own characteristic. We need to use some suited methods together to solve this problem. To the current status of urban congestion and high cost of logistics distribution cost, this paper had constructed distribution center location model in suburbs. Firstly, according to the logistics service demand net, we divide the city by the method of cluster. Then, we use entropy method to estimate the candidate location in each area. Finally, example is given to show the applicability of it, and come to a certain practicality program of distribution center location.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The application and research of spaceflight tracking and controlling software testing process new model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology

articleTitle: Design and development On VxWorks-based GIC monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: The magnetic field fluctuations in the power grid will produce geomagnetic induced currents (GIC) when magnetic storm occurs. Monitoring and analysis of the GIC is an important new task. At present, although the domestic GIC monitoring devices can monitor GIC, they are unfavorable for installation for their large size and weight. This paper proposes a GIC monitoring model which is based on embedded system. The size of the monitoring device with high movability is smaller, which could effectively reduce the cost of installation and maintenance. Furthermore, the VxWorks platform, compared to other development platforms, which are used to develop this system, can improve real-time performance and reliability.

publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology

articleTitle: Information technology training in translator professional education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: The international business and trades bring about urgent need for translators with advanced computational and informational skills. However, there is no consensus on which information technologies should be included in the training courses for translation curriculum. We propose that the computational skills required for professional translators consist of three levels. The first level is the basic ability of operating computer, a general-purpose requirement for civilized people in current information society. The second is a mastery of translation related software, i.e., computer-assisted or machine translation systems. The third is a higher demand on the informational technology of the translator, including customizing and refining current software packages, building their own parallel or comparable corpora, setting up translation memories, dictionaries and term bases, etc. Based on the observation of different levels of computational abilities and reference to other established standards, a corresponding technology course construction for translator training can be put forward.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Learning algorithm of parameters about fuzzy Membership functions based on the RBF neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology

articleTitle: An enterprise flexible object-relational mapping framework based on metadata and property-seperation storage
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: Object-relational mapping plays an important role especially when we deal with large enterprise applications that have to be open and easy to maintain. In this paper, an enterprise flexible object-relational mapping strategy which involves metadata is raised according to the characteristics of data items. Then, the hierarchy of the framework is detailed, and the realization of framework modules is given using the mapping strategy. The framework would greatly facilitate the rapid development of enterprise application in modeling and data operation. The reference framework has features of self-adaptivity, flexibility, scalability, reusability. Using this framework can meet the diversity of user demands without modify the constructure of application.

articleTitle: An automatic Semantic Web Service composition approach based on PDDL
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: In this paper, against the problem of composing Semantic Web Services using AI planner, we proposed an algorithm that translates OWL-S process models to the PDDL actions. After this work, we can choose the most suitable AI planner to compose Web services. The algorithm presented in this paper is an attempted and exploratory work, so there is some shortage in it. The reality that PDDL does not support iteration construct does restrict the ability of express, while some planners have be restricted by this behavior, such as HTN. We will explore PDDL to support this function, either by existing constructs or by developing new construct.

articleTitle: A Semantic Web Services discovery mechanism design and implementation based on OWL Ontology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Educational and Network Technology
abstract: As one of the main purposes, Semantic Web Services (SWS) is proposed to ensure automatic service discovery. However, an effective and dedicated semantic registry for SWS discovery is still desired. Therefore, we propose a mechanism and implement it as prototype for SWS discovery. In the paper, first, we discuss the architecture of the mechanism and its properties as a prototype. Next, design an SWS Model Ontology to store the published SWS. Then, we present an algorithm for SWS discovery in detail. Finally, test the prototype with OWLS-TC3 and point out its highlighted merits. As a result, the mechanism proves to be a weight-light and effective method for SWS discovery.
